facts.stone-throne: He sits facing front on a gray stone throne, with ram's heads carved on the armrests and the top of the backrest.
facts.ankh-scepter: In his right hand he holds a yellow scepter with a loop at the top (an ankh shape).
facts.orb: In his left hand he holds a golden orb.
facts.beard-crown: He has a long white beard and wears a gold crown.
facts.armor: Below the red cloak, his armored legs and iron boots show.
facts.bare-mountains: Behind him rise orange rocky mountains without a blade of grass, and the sky is orange too.

glosses.stone-throne: A structure and a responsibility that do not shake easily.
glosses.bare-mountains: An order built even in a harsh environment.
glosses.armor: Tension that stays on even while seated on the throne; a readiness to protect.

reversedGloss.excess: Rules and control go too far, and it feels suffocating.
reversedGloss.waning: The standards and authority he set lose their force and fall into disarray.

misdescriptions.wrong: The setting is a rich scene of green meadows and a river.
Lion heads are carved on the throne.
